vcareer.description: AI career platform piloted with 150+ real VinUni learners. I set up the baseline LiveKit/WebRTC interview path and developed the CV analysis, CV-to-JD matching and JD Builder workflows. The product entered Track 4 as an already-live product and won 2nd Prize at Codex Community Hackathon Hanoi.

scholarai.title: ScholarAI
scholarai.subtitle: AI-Augmented Research Workspace
scholarai.description: AI-powered engine to discover and read academic papers: hybrid semantic search (dense + BM25), hierarchical chunking, citation-aware chat-with-paper (streaming RAG), and hallucination guardrails (cosine thresholds, scope-enforcing prompts). RAG quality measured with LangSmith (hit rate, citation accuracy, faithfulness).

vcareerCaseStudy.eyebrow: Flagship case study · six-week team build
vcareerCaseStudy.title: VCareer
vcareerCaseStudy.subtitle: AI Career Development Platform
vcareerCaseStudy.summary: A career-practice product connecting CV preparation, job criteria and live AI interviews for a VinUni student pilot. The product remains live while further development is paused pending university funding.

confidence.label: higher confidence reported
confidence.detail: Qualitative feedback; no job-placement uplift claim

problem.title: Connect preparation to the job a student actually wants
problem.body: Career preparation was split between CV review and interview practice. The team began with the idea and interviews with the Product Owner from VinUni Career Services, then built one workflow spanning CV work, JD criteria and a live AI interview.

scope.title: What I owned
scope.intro: My scope was concentrated in the real-time foundation and the CV/JD intelligence layer—not every component shown in the broader product architecture.

realtime.title: LiveKit + WebRTC baseline
realtime.body: Set up the baseline real-time path used by the live AI interview experience.

matching.title: CV analysis and CV-to-JD matching
matching.body: Developed the deeper analysis and matching workflow that turns CV and job criteria into actionable fit feedback.

builder.title: JD Builder
builder.body: Built the workflow used to create and structure job descriptions for downstream analysis and matching.

timeline.title: From discovery to a real learner pilot

discovery.label: Discovery
discovery.title: Idea and Product Owner interviews
discovery.body: The six-week team cycle began in May 2026 with problem framing and interviews with VinUni Career Services.

build.label: Build
build.title: Six weeks from idea to product
build.body: A four-person team developed the product from the initial discovery through a pilot-ready release.

hackathon.label: Recognition
hackathon.title: 2nd Prize · Track 4: Transform with Codex
hackathon.body: VCareer entered the June 27, 2026 Hanoi event as an already-live product, as Track 4 required. It was not built from scratch during the hackathon and received $5,000 in OpenAI API credits.

pilot.label: Pilot
pilot.title: Tested by 150+ real learners
pilot.body: Survey feedback reported higher confidence. CV evaluation and scoring were reviewed by the Product Owner from VinUni Career Services.

architecture.title: Realtime in the browser, evidence in the product workflow
architecture.disclaimer: This section describes the wider product system. My direct ownership is listed above.

realtime.label: Realtime path
realtime.title: Direct WebRTC with ephemeral access
realtime.body: The browser connects through LiveKit for the live interview path; ephemeral credentials keep long-lived secrets out of the client. The Three.js TalkingHead remains part of the interview experience.

application.label: Application layer
application.title: Next.js full-stack + managed data services
application.body: The product uses Next.js 16, Drizzle ORM, Neon PostgreSQL and managed AI services for interview, CV and matching workflows.

storage.label: Storage state
storage.title: Cloudflare R2 and Amazon S3 coexist
storage.body: Both object-storage paths are retained in the current system; this is not a completed R2-to-S3 replacement.

deployment.label: Deployment state
deployment.title: Vercel live; AWS target verified
deployment.body: Production currently runs on Vercel. The AWS Singapore target architecture has been built and verified, while real-user cutover remains pending.

evidence.title: Six views from the live product
evidence.description: The screenshots show the landing flow, CV Builder, CV/job matching, live interview with TalkingHead, interview review and learner dashboard.
